title: Empezar de uno
lesson: Nueva regla maestra: fotografiar lo que una obra conserva, reutiliza o negocia antes de celebrar lo nuevo.
delta_vs_previous: No canonical change; historical additions remain provenance-only.
open_questions: Which current, primary place source verifies any derived Lima scene?
What field evidence would make the relationship legible in one frame?
expert_rejection: A published source can support a conceptual lens, but it cannot verify current scene conditions, access, safety, consent, light, activity, or one-frame strength.
historical_top5: Centro Cívico de Lima / Real Plaza
field_test: What existed before the intervention, and where does that prior condition still control the image?
